title: New crate: yencoding (yEnc encode/decode)
description:
Standalone Rust crate for yEnc encoding and decoding. yEnc is a binary-to-text encoding for Usenet binary posts (2001), offering ~1-2% overhead vs 33% for Base64/UUencode by passing most bytes raw with only 4 escape values.

No dependency on mime-tree, uuencoding, or any other workspace crate.
No filesystem I/O -- all operations on &[u8] and Vec<u8>.
No NZB parsing -- that is a separate concern.

Algorithm:
- Encode: add 42 to each byte (mod 256); escape NUL/LF/CR/= by preceding with = and adding 64 (mod 256); emit backtick for zero (not space) to resist mailer trailing-space stripping; wrap at configured line length (default 128).
- Decode: subtract 42 (wrapping); when = seen, read next byte, subtract 106 (wrapping); discard CR/LF/NUL.

Framing:
- Single-part: =ybegin line= size= name=<to-eol> / data / =yend size= crc32=
- Multi-part: =ybegin part= line= size= name= / =ypart begin= end= / data / =yend size= part= pcrc32= [crc32=]

Design constraints:
- Skip unknown header fields (do not reject); field order must not matter
- Accept both LF and CRLF line endings
- Scan forward for =ybegin (may be embedded in larger body with preceding prose)
- Handle dot-stuffing defensively (.. at line start -> single dot)
- std::error::Error + Display on all error types
- Non-exhaustive error enum
- CRC32 verification via crc32fast
- Independent test vectors (NOT round-trip self-tests); use reference decoder output or spec examples as oracle

Public API shape:
  pub struct YencMetadata { filename: String, size: u64, line_length: u8 }
  pub struct DecodedPart { data: Vec<u8>, metadata: YencMetadata, part: Option<u32>, begin: Option<u64>, end: Option<u64>, crc32_verified: bool, is_truncated: bool }
  pub enum YencError { NoHeader, InvalidHeader{field}, CrcMismatch{expected,actual}, UnexpectedEof }
  pub fn decode(input: &[u8]) -> Result<DecodedPart, YencError>
  pub fn encode(data: &[u8], filename: &str) -> Vec<u8>   // single-part
  pub fn encode_part(data: &[u8], filename: &str, total_size: u64, part: u32, begin: u64, end: u64) -> Vec<u8>  // one part of multi
